PS2:suggoi-arcana-heart-2.d: Suggoi! Arcana Heart 2 is a fighting game for the PlayStation 2, published by AQ Interactive in 2008.

PS4:dungeon-encounters.d: Dungeon Encounters is a 2021 role-playing video game developed by Square Enix and Cattle Call and published by Square Enix. It was released for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and Windows. At the time of its release, Dungeon Encounters was the first game Hiroyuki Ito had directed in 14 years. The game received positive reviews from critics for its minimalist approach to gameplay.

PS4:omega-strikers.d: Omega Strikers is a free-to-play action sport video game by Odyssey Interactive. The game features short, three-on-three online multiplayer matches, in which players compete to score more goals than the opposing team. It was released on April 27, 2023 for Microsoft Windows, Nintendo Switch, iOS and Android,, May 2nd for PlayStation 5, May 5 for Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S, and on May 19 for PlayStation 4.

PS4:yars-recharged.d: Yars: Recharged is a twin-stick shooter developed by Vancouver-based company Adamvision Studios and published by Atari. It is a remake of Yars' Revenge, a 1982 Atari 2600 shooter. It was released on August 23, 2022, for Atari VCS, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Stadia, Windows, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch. Unlike the previous remake, Yar's Revenge, it stays significantly closer to the source material, with top-down neo-retro style graphics and its Yar protagonist being an anthropomorphic fly.

PS5:kinki-spiritual-affairs-bureau.d: Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau is an action horror game for the PlayStation 5 in 2024.

Xbox:dead-to-rights-2.d: Dead to Rights II is a third-person shooter video game developed by Widescreen Games and published by Namco Hometek. It is a prequel to Dead to Rights. A prequel to Dead to Rights II for the PlayStation Portable, titled Dead to Rights: Reckoning, was released in June 2005.

X360:need-for-speed-prostreet.d: Need for Speed: ProStreet is a 2007 racing video game developed by EA Black Box and published by Electronic Arts. It is the eleventh installment in the Need for Speed series and a follow-up to Need for Speed: Carbon (2006). Unlike its immediate predecessors, which focused on the contemporary illegal street racing scene, ProStreet focuses on legal circuit races that take place on closed tracks. The game blends elements of both sim and arcade racing games, requiring players to customize and tune cars for various race modes.

X360:qubed.d: Qubed is a shoot 'em up game for the Xbox 360, developed by Q Entertainment and published by Sonic Team in 2009.

X360:r-i-p-d-game.d: R.I.P.D. The Game is a co-op third-person shooter video game based on the 2013 film R.I.P.D.. It was developed by Old School Games and published by Atlus USA. It was released on July 17, 2013, for the Xbox 360, PlayStation 3 and Microsoft Windows. The gameplay is derived from Old School Games' previous game, God Mode. Players in R.I.P.D. The Game are able to play as Roy Pulsipher or Nick Walker in a cooperative horde mode gametype against renegade ghosts also known as "deadoes", who stay on earth to avoid their fate in the afterlife.

XOne:hazel-sky.d: Hazel Sky is an adventure game for the Xbox One, developed by Coffee Addict Studio and published by Neon Doctrine in 2022.

XSX:no-mans-sky.d: No Man's Sky is an action-adventure survival game developed and published by Hello Games. It was released worldwide for the PlayStation 4 and Windows in August 2016, for Xbox One in July 2018, for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and Series S consoles in November 2020, for Nintendo Switch in October 2022, for macOS in June 2023, and Nintendo Switch 2 in June 2025. The iOS version was released in October 28 and 29, 2026. The game is built around four pillars: exploration, survival, combat, and trading.

XSX:space-gladiators.d: Space Gladiators is an action game for the Xbox Series X|S, developed by Thomas Gervraud and published by Seaven Studio in 2021.

XSX:winter-games-2023.d: Winter Games 2023 is a sports game for the Xbox Series X|S, developed by Independent Arts Software and published by Wild River Games in 2022.

N64:milos-astro-lanes.d: Milo's Astro Lanes is a 1998 bowling game for the Nintendo 64 developed by Player 1 and published by Crave Entertainment. The game takes place in a space setting where there are intergalactic bowling alleys. It makes use of the Rumble Pak and the Controller Pak. The latter must be used for the former to be used.

Wii:pop.d: Pop is a WiiWare and iOS video game by Australian developer Nnooo. The game was released in 2008, in North America on May 12 as a WiiWare launch title, and in Europe on July 4. It was released by Electronic Arts in Japan on July 29 of the same year. The iOS version was released on the App Store on March 5, 2009.

Switch:turok-2-seeds-of-evil.d: Turok 2: Seeds of Evil is a first-person shooter video game developed by Iguana Entertainment and published by Acclaim Entertainment. It was released for the Nintendo 64 console in 1998 and ported to Microsoft Windows computers in 1999. Seeds of Evil is the second game in the Turok video game series and a sequel to Turok: Dinosaur Hunter. The game follows the story of a Turok and his efforts to stop a powerful alien entity from escaping the confines of his Lightship.

GB:populous.d: Populous is a video game developed by Bullfrog Productions and published by Electronic Arts for the Amiga in March 1989, then quickly the Atari ST and MS-DOS. Many conversions followed, including for the Genesis, Super NES, and PC Engine consoles. Populous is considered the first god game. With over four million copies sold, Populous is one of the best-selling PC games of all time. The player assumes the role of a deity, who must lead followers through direction, manipulation, and divine intervention, with the goal of eliminating the followers led by the opposite deity.

GBA:killer-3d-pool.d: Killer 3D Pool is a sports game for the Game Boy Advance, developed by Gravity-i and published by Zoo Digital Publishing in 2005.

It is the first Super Robot Wars (SRW) game for the 3DS and was released in Japan on March 14, 2013. The theme of this game is "Possibilities".

It was positively received by critics, who praised its gameplay and visual appearance.

Linux:riot-civil-unrest.d: Riot: Civil Unrest (stylized as RIOT: Civil Unrest) is a 2019 real time strategy video game that simulates riots based on real events. The project started with a successful Indiegogo campaign in February 2014 and entered early access in December 2017. The director of the game and previously an editor and cinematographer at Valve, Leonard Menchiari, has experienced riots personally and the game was created as a way to express it and to tell the stories of these events. The player can pick between playing as police or rioters.

iOS:settlers-4.d: The Settlers IV (German: Die Siedler IV), released as The Settlers: Fourth Edition in North America, is a 2001 real-time strategy video game with city-building elements for Windows, iOS, webOS, bada, Symbian, and Android. Developed by Blue Byte and published by Ubi Soft, the Windows version was released in Germany in February 2001, in the United Kingdom in March, and in North America in August. Also in August, Blue Byte released an expansion, The Settlers IV Mission CD, featuring new single-player campaign missions, new maps for both single-player and multiplayer modes, a random map generator and map editor, gameplay improvements, and bug fixes.
